catalysts.name: Qnity Electronics, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: adjusted EPS $1.46 and revenue $1.56B, both above consensus (sources differ slightly on the exact beat size, roughly 21-24%). Raised FY2026 guidance: adjusted EPS to $4.95-5.05 (from $4.40-4.60), revenue to $5.77-5.83B, adjusted EBITDA to $1.785-1.805B. Spun off from DuPont in Oct 2025; first full post-spin quarter to beat and raise.

catalysts.name: SharkNinja, Inc.
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: revenue $1.976B, beat the ~$1.864B consensus; adjusted EPS $2.34 (+56% y/y), with part of the margin gain coming from IEEPA tariff-refund timing (sources note this may not repeat). Raised FY2026 guidance: net sales growth to 18-19% (from 16-17%), adjusted diluted EPS to $6.65-6.75 (from $6.45-6.55).

catalysts.name: Elanco Animal Health Incorporated
catalysts.what: Q3 2026: revenue ~$1.27B (+11% y/y, sources differ slightly between $1.26-1.27B) and adjusted EPS $0.27, above the ~$0.20-0.25 consensus. Raised FY2026 guidance: adjusted EPS to $1.17-1.20 (from $1.10-1.16) and revenue to $5.16-5.18B (from $5.09-5.14B). Shares +~7.6-8.7% on the print.

Q.what: Supplies electronic materials and specialty chemicals used in semiconductor chip manufacturing; spun off from DuPont in October 2025.

SN.what: Designs and sells small home appliances (vacuums, kitchen and outdoor cooking products, air purifiers) under the Shark and Ninja brands.

ELAN.what: Animal-health company making parasiticides, vaccines and therapeutics for pets and livestock, including the Seresto, Advantage and Rumensin brands.
